name: M-CSF-driven osteoclast lineage development
rationale: Members cover macrophage/osteoclast proliferation, fusion, differentiation and bone resorption with CSF1 and interleukin receptor signalling; M-CSF signalling separates it from C1, and osteoclast/bone members separate it from the monocyte/DC differentiation confusables C2-C3.

name: Platelet activation and aggregation via soluble-agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation and coagulation; ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling distinguish it from C1/C3 (adhesion/GPIb), and aggregation/coagulation from the integrin-Rap C4.

name: Planar cell polarity driving convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and the convergent extension/neural plate morphogenesis it drives; convergent extension in axis elongation and organogenesis is what C2/C4 lack, while C1/C3 are axial mesoderm patterning.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase via Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenoceptors; the adrenergic receptor context separates it from C2 (muscarinic/adenosine) and the cyclase-level regulation from C1/C3 (catecholamine secretion) and C4 (PKA activation).

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib
rationale: Members are NK receptor signatures and positive/negative regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity; MHC class Ib presentation and NK activation restraint distinguish it from C1/C2, and tumour-directed/T cell cytotoxicity from C3/C4 (KIR, tolerance).

name: Mesenchymal morphogenesis of embryonic face and limbs
rationale: Members are craniofacial (palate, nose, neuro/viscerocranium) and limb/digit morphogenesis plus mesenchymal cell development; limbs and anterior head distinguish it from the pharyngeal-organ confusables C1/C2/C4, and lack of ossification from C3.

name: Fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover integrin production, focal adhesion assembly, fibronectin matrix formation, SRF cytoskeletal remodelling and fibroblast migration; focal adhesion assembly and collagen/TGFB matrix separate it from integrin/syndecan confusables, and fibronectin/migration from the EMT confusable C3.

name: Restraint of skeletal muscle growth, including disuse atrophy
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube development, satellite cell maintenance, atrophy and inactivity responses; atrophy/inactivity distinguishes it from the pro-myogenic C4, and myogenesis restraint from the hypertrophy/contraction confusables C1-C3.

name: Break-induced replication in recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members concern recombination-based telomere maintenance (D-loop, t-circle, capping) with break-induced replication, unwinding and mitotic recombination resolution, which are what C1-C4 lack.

name: cAMP production driving PKA activation
rationale: Members are cAMP synthesis, forskolin response and PKA activation; cAMP biosynthesis and cyclic-nucleotide GPCR coupling separate it from the CREB/cyclase-activation confusables, and stimulation separates it from the cyclase-inhibitory C2.

core: Vesicle traffic between Golgi and ER
name: COPI vesicle traffic between Golgi and ER
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting and COPI budding/retrograde traffic between ER and Golgi; COPI distinguishes it from the COPII confusables C3/C4 and targeting/ER exit from the tethering C1 and ER-insertion C2.

name: Metanephric kidney development with nephron tubule patterning
rationale: All members concern kidney development from intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct to nephron; nephron tubule segment development and proximal/distal patterning are what the ureteric-bud-induction confusables lack.

name: Endocytic recycling of receptors to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern endosome organisation and recycling of cargo back to the plasma membrane; this distinguishes it from the endosome-to-Golgi C2 and tubulation C4, and vesicular cholesterol/Golgi export from the secretory C1/C3.

name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining terminal differentiation
rationale: Members are progenitor transcription programmes (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis) and negative regulation of granulocyte/monocyte/macrophage differentiation; the restraint and progenitor proliferation distinguish it from confusables carrying positive differentiation and mature-cell modules.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK signalling and its feedback inactivation
rationale: Members are RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation including oncogenic mutants and ERK dephosphorylation/negative feedback; ERK inactivation separates it from C2/C3, and RAF mutant signalling from C1/C4.

name: Redox-active vitamin metabolism, including protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members concern vitamin K, C and E metabolism and responses with vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation; gamma-carboxylation separates it from oxygen-transport C1, and ascorbate from vitamin E/D confusables C2-C4.

name: Dendritic cell chemokine production via cGAMP-STING sensing
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production with cGAMP import and STING activation; STING sensing distinguishes it from C1/C2 (Th1, macrophage chemokines), and DC chemokine output from the IFN/TLR confusables C3/C4.

name: Noncoding RNA methylation and small RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation with snoRNP/snRNP assembly and localisation; methylation (vs pseudouridylation) and snRNP biogenesis/cap hypermethylation are what the confusables lack.

name: mRNA stability control during stress-induced translational arrest
rationale: Members are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability with stress granules, PKR and translational silencing; translational repression separates it from the ARE-decay confusables C1/C2/C4, and stress granules/PKR from C3.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation in cartilage and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy with cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis; joint morphogenesis separates it from C1/C2 (ossification, tendon) and cartilage morphogenesis/condensation from C3/C4 (articular homeostasis).

name: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion via KATP channels
rationale: Members concern glucose-, incretin-, fatty-acid- and neurotransmitter-regulated insulin secretion and processing in islets; KATP channel members are what C2 lacks, and secretion control separates it from GLUT4/insulin-signalling confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome turnover with deubiquitinase chain editing
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin chain synthesis by linkage type, deubiquitinase families and proteasome assembly/degradation; DUBs and proteasome distinguish it from the ERAD/autophagy confusables C1/C3 and the neddylation confusables C2/C4.

name: Golgi organisation and traffic regulated by Rab GTPases
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure, COPI/retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic with Rab prenylation, GEFs and GAPs; Rab regulation distinguishes it from C3/C4, and Golgi-ER traffic from the TGN-endosome-lysosome confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are general alpha-amino acid metabolism with proline biosynthesis and catabolism; proline/glutamine-family members distinguish it from the glycine/serine confusables.

name: Retinol uptake and conversion to retinoic acid
rationale: Members are vitamin A/retinol/retinal/retinoic acid metabolism and STRA6 transport; STRA6 uptake separates it from C1/C3/C4 and retinoic acid synthesis from the visual-cycle C2.

name: Telomere capping protecting ends from recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere end packaging, capping and suppression of recombination, NHEJ and telomerase; protection distinguishes it from the C-strand/replication confusables C1/C3/C4 and the telomerase-recruitment C2.

name: Nucleotide cofactor and phosphagen interconversion
rationale: Members concern interconversion and transport of energy carriers (NTP/ADP/ATP, NAD/NADP, phosphocreatine); NTP interconversion separates it from C1, NAD members from C2/C4, and creatine/ADP-ATP transport from C3.

name: Telomere maintenance with Cajal body telomerase trafficking
rationale: Members cover telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, recombination and telomere protection; telomerase RNA/scaRNA trafficking to Cajal bodies is what the DNA-repair confusables C2/C4 lack, and telomere-specific content separates it from C1/C3.

name: Inflammatory cytokine control by TLR2/4 and NLRP inflammasomes
rationale: Members concern bacterial-ligand TLR signalling, NLRP inflammasomes and IL-1 processing regulating inflammatory cytokines; inflammasomes distinguish it from C1/C4 and TLR2/4/LPS sensing from the pyroptosis confusable C3.

name: Canonical Wnt signalling via AXIN destruction complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signalling governed by AXIN/APC destruction-complex stability; AXIN degradation and XAV939 stabilisation are what C1/C2/C4 lack, and destruction-complex mutants/TCF output separate it from C3.
